name: ImageUploader
description: The ImageUploader pattern provides a user-friendly interface for uploading images with preview capabilities, drag-and-drop functionality, and validation.
usage: Creates object URLs for previewing images before upload
Handles file validation before allowing upload
Cleans up object URLs to prevent memory leaks
Fully responsive design with appropriate spacing on all device sizes
Supports single or multiple image uploads
Provides upload progress indication with real-time feedback
Handles error states for validation and upload failures
design: Uses drag-and-drop interface with visual feedback during drag operations
Shows image preview grid for multiple uploaded images
Displays upload progress bars with percentage and status indicators
Provides clear error messages for validation failures
Hover effects reveal delete buttons for uploaded images
Responsive grid layout adapts to different screen sizes
Uses design tokens for colors and spacing
Disabled state when max images reached
Visual feedback for drag-active state with primary color
accessibility: Input has aria-label for screen readers
Delete buttons include title attribute for tooltip
Clear visual states for uploading, error, and success
Progress information conveyed through text and visual indicators
Error messages are clearly associated with the component

props.name: entityId
props.description: The ID of the entity to associate the image with. Use 'temp' for new entities without an ID yet.

props.name: entityType
props.description: The type of entity (e.g., 'journal', 'gallery', 'profile'). Used to determine the correct API endpoint.

props.name: maxImages
props.description: Maximum number of images allowed. Set to 1 for single image upload.

props.name: initialImages
props.description: Initial image URLs if editing an existing entity. Empty strings are filtered out.

props.name: onImagesUploaded
props.description: Callback fired when images are successfully uploaded. Returns array of image URLs.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label displayed above the uploader.

props.name: description
props.defaultValue: "Drag & drop an image here, or click to select"
props.description: Optional description text shown in the upload area.

props.name: preserveFormat
props.description: Whether to preserve the original image format instead of converting.

props.name: hidePreview
props.description: Whether to hide the preview of uploaded images.
